items.label: Dual Charging & Extended Battery Life
items.value: Supports solar and USB-C charging; a 5-minute charge delivers months of use. Features two supercapacitor-boosted batteries that prevents drain damage and lasts over 10 years without disposable batteries.

items.label: Universal Samsung TV Compatibility
items.value: Works with 2018–2025 Samsung models including Neo QLED, OLED, The Frame, and Tizen OS. (Each TV pairs with only one remote.)

items.label: Smart Voice Control
items.value: Enables hands-free commands for content search and volume adjustment—ideal for users with limited mobility.

items.label: Streaming Shortcuts
items.value: Dedicated buttons for Netflix, Prime-Video, Samsung Plus, and Disney+ for instant access. (May not function on some older models.)

items.label: Military-Grade Durability
items.value: Built with ABS plastic to withstand 6.5 ft drops, tested for 100,000+ clicks, and offers 40 ft Bluetooth range through walls.

items.label: 2-Year Service & Zero-Waste Design
items.value: Includes a 2-year care service and USB-C charging cable. Aims to eliminate disposable batteries, supporting a sustainable future.
